samples.name: character-citizen-male-1-dig-frame-1
samples.prompt: Exactly ONE young Slavic peasant character in ONE digging pose with ONE iron pickaxe. NOT a sprite sheet, not multiple poses. Same character as first reference: short brown hair, belted pale blue-grey kosovorotka, trousers, bast shoes. Other references define tiny Kenney pixel style. Single transparent 16x16 logical pixel canvas enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Very simple blocky pixel clusters, no tiny detail. South-facing with slight overhead view. Body centered, feet at bottom row; whole tool inside canvas. Skin exact #f7c282/#e19a65, hair #bd6c4a/#763b36, clothes #c0cbdc/#8b9bb4/#52607c, brown handle, grey curved pointed iron pick head. Flat colors only, no gradients, texture, antialiasing, glow, shadow, scenery, rock, text or additional characters. Pickaxe raised above screen-right shoulder, both hands gripping handle, ready to swing.
